instruction:
`LuthiModel._compute_introspection_delta()` in `sanctuary/core/luthi_model.py` turns per-block substrate stats from before and after a cycle (`self._pre_state["blocks"]`, `self._post_state["blocks"]`) into the entity's per-cycle proprioception delta, `self._introspection_delta`.

LuthiModel now also exposes two more per-block stats: `update_ema_mean` (metaplasticity) and `momentum_abs_mean` (momentum). Add two delta channels:

- `metaplasticity_change` and `momentum_change`: each the mean, over blocks, of post minus pre.
- Count only blocks that have the field in both states. When no block has it (an older substrate), don't add the key at all, and don't raise.
- Don't add either channel to `activity_level`. It must keep aggregating only the plasticity, drift and membrane changes, because it feeds the turbo trigger's running bands and widening it would shift their scale.
pytest_args: not benchmark and not integration and not property

source.subject: feat: feel metaplasticity + momentum — introspection delta consumes new substrate channels
